If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to align with bullish momentum decay.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, cap upward revisions at 1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is below 60.00, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias for late horizon (16–30 days) to counteract bearish drift.  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 after 3 consecutive low sentiment days, shift forecast midpoint 2–3% higher for mid horizon to capture reversal momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.33 and forecast is above 65.00, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon to avoid overestimating upside.  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is below 62.00, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon to reflect bullish sentiment bias.
